description: Per-route inputs for ferry water geometry (see scripts/ferry_water.py). terminals: landing coordinates [start, end] used when the provider path is degenerate. osmWays: OpenStreetMap route=ferry way ids to chain instead of automatic endpoint matching. noOsm: skip automatic OSM matching. controls: hand-drawn control paths tried before provider/OSM geometry. aliases: routes that legitimately share one physical path.

steamship-authority:VH-WH.note: Stale SSA GTFS lists only one stop per trip; draw the OSM-mapped Woods Hole-Vineyard Haven track.

cranberry-isles:commuter.note: Commuter boat calls Great Cranberry then Islesford; follow the two OSM-mapped legs.

cranberry-cove:southwest-harbor-cranberr.note: Manset/Southwest Harbor, Great Cranberry, Islesford via the OSM-mapped Cranberry Cove Ferry legs.

beal-bunker:northeast-harbor-cranberry-i.note: Mailboat calls Sutton (seasonal), Islesford, then Great Cranberry; a different path from the Cranberry Isles Commuter.

jamestown-newport-ferry:hop-on-loop.note: Calls Rose Island, Fort Adams, Ann Street Pier, then Perrotti Park; follow the four OSM-mapped legs.

robin-r:rockland-matinicus.note: Separate small-boat service; keep a hand path distinct from the state ferry's GTFS shape.

ctdot-ferry:rocky-hill-glastonbury.note: The river crossing is mapped in OSM; the hand line was a 160 m stub.

bustins-island-ferry:south-freeport.note: Lilly B from the South Freeport terminal to Steamer Dock. Follow OpenStreetMap way 329759736.
